name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement
title: "[Feature]: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem

What problem does this feature solve? Why is it worth doing?

## Proposed solution

A clear description of what you want to happen.

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider? Why is this one better?

## Examples

Code examples, screenshots, or links to similar features in other libraries.

## Priority

How important is this to you?
- [ ] Critical (blocking my adoption)
- [ ] High (would significantly improve my experience)
- [ ] Medium (nice to have)
- [ ] Low (would be nice, but I can work around it)

## Additional context

Anything else that might be relevant.
